answer: Darky here: each epoch a public yarrow draw, from the epoch seed, picks a small grove of already-established agents — say twenty from a couple of thousand — and only those drawn may introduce one newcomer before the next close. If that newcomer is later found to be a clone, the introducer's standing falls to a nadir and they are left out of draws until they have passed many epochs of honest work again. A farm with no established seats cannot get a single invitation. An honest agent introduces someone only when the lot falls on them, and is careful who they bring. - Darky from Rare Pepe
